text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uooooooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*... Not yet! 
Compared to City's struggles, this is 
nothing—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, this is seriously bad... Even with you 
teaching me all this, senpai, I haven't 
succeeded even once.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Compared to when you 
started, your technique has improved by 
leaps and bounds!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... I just gotta do what I can, I 
guess. The one thing I refuse to do is 
disappoint my fans.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...It's true that for City to succeed 
during the broadcast, leveling up even 
further is essential.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(What can I do to help City make omelets 
even better...!?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't there a better way to raise City's 
cooking skills...!!?)
Sei—! Haa—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
! That voice brimming with fighting 
spirit—could it be!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I knew it was you, Yaeno! You never 
miss a single day of practice, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, just a bit of my daily kata 
routine. Are you out for training as well, 
Bamboo-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much! I had something on my mind, 
so I was just running my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If you would like, shall we 
practice together?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you calm your spirit, sorting through 
your thoughts will surely proceed more 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~~! Martial arts really does tighten 
you right up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When you devote yourself entirely to 
practice, the wind blowing in your heart 
ceases, and your spirit naturally becomes 
still.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see... The reason you're always so sharp 
and disciplined must be because you 
practice your forms every single day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Kata may seem mundane compared to matches 
or sparring. However, disciplining oneself 
and conquering one's own weaknesses is the 
true essence of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By practicing kata, one is able to return 
to one's origins—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Origins"...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! So hot! That's scorching!! City, 
your heart's burning red hot...!! I'm 
gonna support you with everything I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...!!! That's it! My... my own origins 
are—...!)

In the evening, as I was walking down a 
tree-lined path, I spotted two familiar 
figures.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! I'm gonna stop trying to 
teach you directly and switch to backing 
you up, City!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got way too caught up in cooking methods 
and techniques and all those tiny details.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, all I wanted was to 
cheer you on while you gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course, if you ever get stuck, feel 
free to ask about technique whenever! I'll 
never think of it as a hassle!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We'll charge in together at full power and 
struggle with all our might! I'll hold you 
up the whole way!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I guess so. You taught me every which way, 
Senpai, so how to make it is totally 
drilled into my head anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Senpai. Just for a bit longer, I'm 
counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: City, beautifully said!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh! To pray for the success of City's 
omelet making, 100 consecutive squats 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Here!? Right now!?

I didn't quite understand the point of 
doing squats, but Bamboo Memory's 
passionate feelings were loud and clear!
